name: benchmark-b
purpose: Semantic vulnerability classes the deterministic structural analyzer has no capability for; matched vulnerable/secure pairs.

groundTruth.compilation: all 16 contracts compile with solc 0.8.28+commit.7893614a (solcjs), see eval/ground-truth/compile-corpus.mjs
groundTruth.behaviour: verify-behaviour.mjs executes every pair in an in-memory EVM: each vulnerable variant exhibits its labelled defect, each secure variant does not (8/8 at freeze)
groundTruth.labelLines: every label line lies inside its labelled function and is non-empty (checked by eval/bench/benchmark.ts checkLabels)

manifest: MANIFEST.sha256 covers contracts/, labels.json and verify-behaviour.mjs; MANIFEST.sha256.sum is the hash of the manifest
